## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| built-and-validated-asset | The delivered dashboard, report, workflow, app or agent | Requester, plant owner | Passed the validation checklist; Reconciled with the paper record for the same period; Delivered and explained to the requester |
| asset-build-protocol | `assets/asset-build-protocol.md`, filled | `deploy-acceptance`, `deploy-handover` | Records output asset, utilization expectation, named plant owner role and data path |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `dept-governance`, `ops-event-model`, `mi-data-availability`, `catalog-usecase`
- **Next:** step 1a3 catalog-guardrails on Lane 1a; step 1b4 on Lane 1b; in Lane 2, step 23 funnel-prototype.: `catalog-guardrails`, `funnel-prototype`
- **Next:** Then deploy-acceptance and deploy-handover, which read the protocol.: `deploy-acceptance`, `deploy-handover`
- **Stops here when:** the data gap is real, the smell checks fail (no ritual, decision or action owner), validation fails, or the insight is a one-off
- **Stops here when:** Close it as ad-hoc and do not industrialize
- **Stops here when:** Publishing externally needs the responsible human, and an agent never marks the asset accepted before the paper reconciliation is signed
